root_causes.shulker_crash: ShulkerGuiColors called the development-mapped ClientLevel.getBlockState signature from the production client
root_causes.missing_luxium_shadows: NeoSkyCelestia rejected its shadow pipeline whenever the Oculus mod ID was installed, even while Oculus shaders were disabled
root_causes.one_way_switch: Only the JEM Luxium option observed renderer ownership, so enabling Oculus directly did not clear Luxium
root_causes.luxium_toggle_crash: JEM Luxium 1.0.3 called SodiumWorldRenderer.reload directly from the Apply-button mouse callback outside Embeddium's managed OpenGL context

renderer_contract.enable_luxium: disable Oculus shaders, enable Luxium, request an Embeddium rebuild through LevelRenderer.allChanged
renderer_contract.enable_oculus: disable Luxium, clear the temporary restore marker, request an Embeddium rebuild through LevelRenderer.allChanged
renderer_contract.disable_luxium: restore the remembered Oculus state and request an Embeddium rebuild through LevelRenderer.allChanged

cinematic_contract.side_panels: disable Cinematic Interaction recipe-book and field-guide panels and expose the ordinary JEI left and right overlays
cinematic_contract.quick_transfer: hold Shift and left mouse button while sweeping slots in either direction between an integrated Cinematic container and inventory
